Great to meet you and the FinLytics team on the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

   - Economic buyer: you indicated CFO/Head of Data (please confirm name)
   - Security: Daniel Ortiz, CISO (we’d like an intro if not already included)

3) Timeline and next meeting
   - Proposed: 30-min security kickoff with your CISO + 1 engineer. Options: Wed 11/11 10:00–10:30 ET or Thu 11/12 14:00–14:30 ET. 

4) Decision criteria (what matters most)
   - Performance (latency under typical loads), data residency, vendor controls for access & auditability, and cost predictability. If there are other mandatory gates please flag them here.

- I’ll share Redwood’s completed questionnaire and a short one-pager on systems in scope. (Attachment: redwood-security-questionnaire-v2.pdf)
- Marissa will draft a mutual action plan and calendar invite for the security kickoff once we confirm attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.
